subject.title: #95939 regression: bootstrapMaxChars/bootstrapTotalMaxChars deleted on every restart

question: Should the Gateway agent tool be allowed to persistently change the existing bootstrap limit config paths, or should this issue be fixed only in the restart/doctor persistence path if the deletion is reproduced?
rationale: The observable source gap is a model-to-operator config write guard, not just a plain persistence bug; changing it affects a deliberate security boundary and the full restart deletion has not been proven on current main.

options.title: Require proof before boundary change
options.body: Keep this issue open until a current-main restart or live config-write repro identifies the failing path, then review a narrow fix against that proof.

options.title: Approve narrow bootstrap write access
options.body: Accept that agents may persistently tune these existing bootstrap limits and require tests covering default and per-agent paths plus protected-path non-regression.

options.title: Keep model writes protected
options.body: If the deletion is reproduced outside the agent tool, fix only the restart or doctor persistence path and leave `config.apply`/`config.patch` unable to change these limits.

recommendation.title: Require proof before boundary change
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a current-main restart or live config-write repro identifies the failing path, then review a narrow fix against that proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged work owns the Gateway config mutation guard being considered for expansion.
